evals.prompt: 把附件里的旧版 .doc 设备说明书统一排版。封面和目录不要页码，正文从1开始，页脚写第X页/共Y页；页眉用封面完整标题但不要公司名，左侧加竖线。标题、正文和表格按我们之前的规则。
evals.expected_output: A new verified DOCX preserving content and media, with standardized headings/fonts/tables, updated TOC, front matter without visible header/footer, and body PAGE/SECTIONPAGES fields.

evals.prompt: 继续处理这份玉米加工设备说明书，其他要求和前面一样。重点检查三级标题编号、目录页码、图片位置以及最后一页的总页数。不要覆盖原文件。
evals.expected_output: A separately named DOCX that applies the stored formatting standard, correctly infers the prior requirements, updates numbering and TOC, and visually verifies representative and final pages.

evals.prompt: 这份 docx 已经有页眉页脚，但总页数把封面和目录算进去了。请修正为正文独立计页，并顺便统一中文黑体/宋体和西文 Times New Roman，表头灰底加粗。
evals.expected_output: A corrected DOCX using a body section restarted at 1, PAGE plus SECTIONPAGES footer fields, clean front matter, correct fonts and table styling, with no content loss or extra blank page.

evals.prompt: 两个说明书最后一页是背面，都是不计入页码的。按前面的说明书排版规则处理，正文页脚仍用第X页/共Y页，但最后背面页不要页眉页脚，也不要算进共Y页。
evals.expected_output: Each DOCX uses three logical sections: front matter, body, and an unnumbered final back-cover section. Body footers use live PAGE plus SECTIONPAGES fields, all body footer variants match, the final back-cover page is blank in header/footer, no extra blank page is introduced, TOC and fields are updated, and footer Chinese literals are not corrupted.
